description: JavaScript code for managing PDF template variables and content insertion in SuiteCRM's AOS_PDF_Templates module, including functions for populating variables, inserting content into TinyMCE editors, and handling sample templates.

methods.name: showVariable
methods.description: Sets the value of the variable_text input to the selected field.

methods.name: setType
methods.description: Sets the type value and populates module variables accordingly.

methods.name: populateVariables
methods.description: Populates the variable_name dropdown with options based on the selected type.

methods.name: populateModuleVariables
methods.description: Populates the module_name dropdown and calls populateVariables.

methods.name: insert_variable
methods.description: Inserts the specified text into the TinyMCE editor for description.

methods.name: insertSample
methods.description: Loads a sample template into the editors, with confirmation if current content exists.
